title: JetBrains Central Console — Admin Cheat Sheet
brandSub: AI Governance · Usage Analytics · Centralized Billing · Policy Control

rows.label: Console URL
rows.value: console.jetbrains.cloud/org/<org-UUID> — unique per org

rows.label: Login
rows.value: Use existing account.jetbrains.com credentials; no separate account needed

rows.label: Target audience
rows.value: Team leads, CTOs, engineering managers — not individual developers

rows.label: EAP status
rows.value: Product is in Early Access Program; all orgs on Basic plan with free Business preview

rows.label: First-time setup
rows.value: Accept Terms and Conditions, assign licenses to users, then enable AI

rows.label: Enable AI
rows.value: AI governance → Settings → click On, accept JetBrains AI Platform Terms

rows.label: Propagation delay
rows.value: Settings changes may take up to one hour to take effect org-wide

rows.label: Help center
rows.value: Sidebar ? icon → Read documentation, Share feedback, or Contact support

rows.label: AI Policies (EAP)
rows.value: Business plan preview — control tools, agents, & BYOK providers per policy

rows.label: AI Providers (EAP)
rows.value: Business plan preview — centrally configure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI

rows.label: Agents page (EAP)
rows.value: Business plan preview — manage ACP-compatible agents from global registry or add custom ones

rows.label: Analytics API v2 (EAP)
rows.value: Business plan preview — POST-body requests, principalType filter, token-usage endpoints

rows.label: AI token usage segment
rows.value: New analytics segment: token consumption by provider & model (v2 API only)

rows.label: Shared AI credit pool
rows.value: Replaces per-user quota; org pool with monthly per-user limit; trial credits consumed first

rows.label: Corporate trials
rows.value: Eligible orgs can activate one-time trial that adds credits to shared pool

rows.label: Cloud runs policy flag
rows.value: New General tab toggle on default policy to allow/deny remote cloud agent execution

rows.label: Teams sidebar
rows.value: Licensing → Teams; subdivisions of licenses within an org

rows.label: Create team
rows.value: Teams → Create New Team; creator becomes team admin automatically

rows.label: Merge teams
rows.value: Team Administration → Merge; licenses & admins transfer, AI settings of target team kept

rows.label: Delete team
rows.value: Only empty teams can be deleted; teams tied to License Vault cannot be deleted

rows.label: Invite team admin
rows.value: Team → Administration → Invite Administrator → copy or email invitation link

rows.label: Transfer licenses
rows.value: Licensing → Licenses → select → Manage → Transfer X licenses to another team

rows.label: Org admin role
rows.value: Manage organization permission — full read/write access to all Console sections

rows.label: Merge organizations
rows.value: Submit Sales request; licenses, teams, org admins, and contacts are transferred

rows.label: Add user
rows.value: Users and access → Users → Add user (name + email required)

rows.label: Remove user
rows.value: User ... menu → Remove user from organization; loses all licenses & AI access

rows.label: Assign license (manual)
rows.value: Licensing → Licenses → filter available → Assign → enter email & name

rows.label: Bulk invitation
rows.value: Licensing → Teams → team → Invitations → Create Invitation → share link

rows.label: Revoke license
rows.value: Products and services → Active subscriptions → select → Manage → Revoke X licenses

rows.label: Grant AI access
rows.value: AI governance → Access → Grant access → select users or service accounts

rows.label: Revoke AI access
rows.value: AI governance → Access → row ⋯ → Revoke access

rows.label: Groups
rows.value: Users and access → Groups; local groups manageable; synced groups come from IdP

rows.label: AI Assistant
rows.value: IDE plugin: context-aware chat, code completion, next edit suggestions, commit messages

rows.label: Junie
rows.value: JetBrains coding agent; Code and Ask modes; data included in activity analytics

rows.label: Claude Agent
rows.value: Anthropic agent in AI Assistant; credit consumption tracked only via JetBrains AI path

rows.label: OpenAI Codex
rows.value: OpenAI agent in AI Assistant; add supported model to OpenAI provider card to enable

rows.label: JetBrains Air
rows.value: Agentic development environment (ADE) — delegates tasks to multiple agents concurrently

rows.label: Central CLI
rows.value: wire IDE filter value in API; routes CLI agents through JetBrains Central for unified billing

rows.label: ACP agents
rows.value: Agent Client Protocol — global registry agents auto-added; cannot be deleted from list

rows.label: View products
rows.value: Licensing → Products and services; click Active subscriptions per product

rows.label: Default policy
rows.value: Auto-created for every org; all principals with AI access assigned; cannot be deleted

rows.label: Save policy changes
rows.value: Blue dot = unsaved; click Save upper-right, then confirm; propagation takes minutes

rows.label: Provider setting
rows.value: General tab → Provider dropdown; agents unsupported by selected provider appear greyed out

rows.label: Cloud runs toggle
rows.value: General tab → Cloud runs; enables/disables remote cloud agent sessions for principals

rows.label: Restrict agents
rows.value: Agents tab → toggle off All available agents → Add agent to allow specific ones

rows.label: BYOK per-user
rows.value: Tools tab → AI Assistant card → Third-party AI providers toggle (default: enabled)

rows.label: Custom ACP agents
rows.value: Tools tab → AI Assistant card → Custom ACP agents toggle (default: enabled)

rows.label: Custom agent JSON
rows.value: Agents → New custom agent; only name field validated; verify ACP format manually

rows.label: Default limit
rows.value: AI governance → Settings → JetBrains Central tab → AI credits per user per month

rows.label: Per-user limit
rows.value: AI governance → Access → Credit limit column → click value → set or reset to default

rows.label: Bulk limit change
rows.value: Select multiple users via checkboxes → Change credit limit toolbar button

rows.label: Auto-purchase
rows.value: AI settings → Configure auto-purchase; monthly or yearly; min 5 credits per period

rows.label: Credit priority order
rows.value: Trial/compensation → license-included → regular → postpaid; earliest expiry consumed first

rows.label: Credit expiry
rows.value: Regular credits: 12 months; license-included: last day of license expiry month

rows.label: Near-limit alert
rows.value: Balance used ≥ 80% triggers Users almost out of AI credits link in info card

rows.label: Buy credits
rows.value: AI governance → Access → AI credits available card → + icon → checkout

rows.label: Analytics sections
rows.value: Usage → AI Analytics: Adoption & usage, Activity & impact, Credit consumption, Providers & models

rows.label: AI contribution rate
rows.value: AI-generated committed LOC ÷ (AI + human LOC); IntelliJ IDEA only, via VCS integration

rows.label: Code acceptance rate
rows.value: Accepted suggestions ÷ total generated lines; chat agents and in-editor features combined

rows.label: Active consumers chart
rows.value: Unique principals making ≥1 credit-spending request per period; each counted once per bar

rows.label: Limit-hits table
rows.value: Lists consumer name/email and date each hit monthly credit limit; daily aggregation

rows.label: IDE version requirements
rows.value: IDE 2025.3.0+, AI Assistant 2025.3.0+, Junie 253.487.77+ for activity & impact data

rows.label: Download CSV
rows.value: Click download icon next to any chart; credit consumption includes all pages of data

rows.label: Share feedback
rows.value: Bottom of any analytics page → Share feedback form to request additional metrics

rows.label: Base URL
rows.value: https://api.jetbrains.cloud/metrics/

rows.label: Auth flow
rows.value: OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials; POST to oauth.account.jetbrains.com/api/rest/oauth2/token

rows.label: Token request
rows.value: grant_type=client_credentials&scope=jcp-public; token valid 60 minutes

rows.label: Auth header
rows.value: Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)

rows.label: v2 adoption endpoint
rows.value: POST /api/v2/adoption/users-adoption/group-by/date — supports principalType

rows.label: v2 token usage
rows.value: POST /api/v2/token-usage/group-by/date-provider — new in v2; not in v1

rows.label: v1 deprecation
rows.value: /api/v1/adoption/limit-hits/group-by/date-principal.cursor deprecated; use v2 equivalent

rows.label: Required permission
rows.value: Service account must have View AI Analytics role to access any Analytics API endpoint

rows.label: Supported BYOK
rows.value: OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock; JetBrains AI always available as default

rows.label: Add provider
rows.value: AI governance → Providers → Add provider → fill credentials → Connect

rows.label: OpenAI endpoint
rows.value: Default https://api.openai.com; use regional endpoint for data residency

rows.label: Vertex AI key
rows.value: Paste full JSON service account key; requires Vertex AI Service Agent IAM role

rows.label: Bedrock model ID
rows.value: Exact regional ID required; base = in-region, us. prefix = geo, global. = worldwide

rows.label: Test connection
rows.value: Provider card → Test connection; tests auth only — use Check connection per model

rows.label: Delete provider
rows.value: Cannot delete while selected in default policy; switch policy provider first

rows.label: Activate via policy
rows.value: Providers alone do nothing — specify provider in an AI policy General tab to apply it

rows.label: Purpose
rows.value: Local CLI proxy routing agent requests through JetBrains Central — no per-provider API keys

rows.label: Supported agents
rows.value: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and other ACP-compatible CLI agents

rows.label: Billing
rows.value: Usage attributed to the user; deducted from org shared AI credit pool like IDE usage

rows.label: IDE filter value
rows.value: Use wire in ide filter of Analytics API to isolate Central CLI consumption

rows.label: Docs
rows.value: Full setup guide at jetbrains.com/help/central-cli/

rows.label: Auth
rows.value: Users authenticate via JetBrains Account; org AI access must be enabled in Console first

rows.label: No BYOK needed
rows.value: Replaces provider-specific API keys; billing consolidated in Console Usage section

rows.label: Air integration
rows.value: JetBrains Air users authenticate the same way; cloud execution uses service account credits

rows.label: Subscription packs
rows.value: Billing → Subscription packs; group with shared billing cycle, payment method, & renewal date

rows.label: Co-terming
rows.value: All pack subscriptions aligned to earliest renewal date; auto on renewal or manual anytime

rows.label: Move subscriptions
rows.value: Pack Overview → select licenses → Pay → Change Subscription Pack for X licenses

rows.label: Auto-renewal
rows.value: Subscription packs → Setup payment; disable via Disable auto-renewal button

rows.label: Cancel subscription
rows.value: Licensing → Licenses → select → Pay → Stop payments for X licenses; active until expiry

rows.label: Upgrade/downgrade
rows.value: Licensing → Licenses → select → Upgrade → switch product; unused days credited at checkout

rows.label: Plans
rows.value: Basic (free), Business ($20/seat/month), Enterprise (on request); EAP = free Business preview

rows.label: Model pricing
rows.value: 1 AI credit = $1 USD spent on provider side; e.g., Claude 4.6 Sonnet: $3 input/$15 output per 1M tokens

rows.label: Org management
rows.value: JetBrains Account org pages migrated to Console; individual licenses stay in JetBrains Account

rows.label: Auth method
rows.value: Console uses JetBrains Account for SSO — no separate credentials created

rows.label: Admin roles sync
rows.value: All JetBrains Account admin roles & contacts auto-transferred to Console on migration

rows.label: AI settings mapping
rows.value: JetBrains Account → AI Settings → now at AI governance → Settings in Console

rows.label: AI access mapping
rows.value: JetBrains Account → JetBrains AI Settings → now at AI governance → Access

rows.label: Teams mapping
rows.value: JetBrains Account → Org → Teams → now Licensing → Teams (same data)

rows.label: New in Console only
rows.value: Dashboard, Users & access section, Usage → Analytics, Groups, Service accounts

rows.label: Verified domains
rows.value: Not transferred during org merge; re-add manually under Organization → Administration

rows.label: Pilot rollout
rows.value: Enable AI for a single team first; use Grant access per user rather than org-wide toggle

rows.label: Least-privilege roles
rows.value: Assign AI viewer or AI analytics viewer before promoting to AI admin

rows.label: Set budgets first
rows.value: Configure default & per-user credit limits before broad AI enablement to prevent runaway spend

rows.label: Staged policy changes
rows.value: EAP policies can change before GA; test on default policy; blue dot warns of unsaved edits

rows.label: Monitor limit hits
rows.value: Check Number of AI consumers who hit their limit chart weekly; raise limits proactively

rows.label: Compare adoption vs cost
rows.value: Cross-reference Active AI consumers chart with AI credit consumption chart monthly

rows.label: Service account hygiene
rows.value: Rotate client secrets regularly; deleting a service account immediately revokes its access

rows.label: 2FA enforcement
rows.value: Organization → Administration → Require 2FA; users have 7 days to comply before lockout

rows.label: Org admin
rows.value: Manage organization — full access to all Console sections

rows.label: AI admin
rows.value: Manage AI settings + Manage AI access + View AI analytics

rows.label: AI viewer
rows.value: View AI settings + View AI access + View AI analytics

rows.label: AI analytics viewer
rows.value: View AI analytics only — narrowest role for BI/reporting consumers

rows.label: Licensing & billing manager
rows.value: Manage licensing and billing + Manage purchases + View licenses

rows.label: Group-scoped roles
rows.value: Scope = Groups; only AI access & AI analytics permissions supported at group scope

rows.label: Create custom role
rows.value: Users and access → Roles → New role; scope cannot be changed after creation

rows.label: Team admin (special)
rows.value: Manages only one team's licenses; granted by purchase or invitation; no org-wide visibility

rows.label: Create service account
rows.value: Users and access → Service accounts → Add service account; copy secret immediately

rows.label: Rotate secret
rows.value: Service account ⋯ → View credentials → Rotate secret; old tokens valid until expiry

rows.label: Get access token
rows.value: POST oauth.account.jetbrains.com/api/rest/oauth2/token with scope=jcp-public

rows.label: Token lifetime
rows.value: Access tokens expire after 3600 seconds; refresh tokens not supported

rows.label: AI credit attribution
rows.value: User-initiated actions billed to user; background service account tasks billed to account

rows.label: JetBrains Account API
rows.value: Separate REST API at account.jetbrains.com/api-doc; headers: X-Customer-Code + X-Api-Key

rows.label: Revoke user token
rows.value: Organization → Administration → Users with access → Revoke in API Token column

rows.label: System service accounts
rows.value: Auto-created by external integrations; cannot be modified but can be deleted by org admin
